run_emotion_dataset_generation: run the Emotion class to generate 16-shot k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_emotion_classification_dataset: create an Emotion classification dataset instance with six emotion labels from Hugging Face
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face emotion dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
load_emotion_dataset: load the emotion dataset from Hugging Face using the datasets library
review_emotion_class: review the Emotion class and its six emotion labels for classification tasks
